CVE-2026-56411 is an integer overflow in endDoctypeDecl via NOTATION declarations within the xmlwf command-line tool, which Debian ships in the separate expat binary package. This miniconda3 image installs only the libexpat1 shared-library package (the Scout evidence lists solely libexpat.so.1.10.2, libexpatw.so.1.10.2, and the libexpat1 dpkg metadata). The xmlwf binary at /usr/bin/xmlwf is not present in the image and cannot be invoked, and Python and conda link the libexpat shared library directly rather than shelling out to xmlwf, so the vulnerable code is not present.
No fix is available for expat in Debian trixie (fixed upstream in libexpat 2.8.1/2.8.2); awaiting a Debian security update.
